contributionMap.claim: Theorem 2.1 and Proposition 6.2: for fixed cost |x-y|^2 on a closed embedded manifold with smooth positive density, the Sinkhorn metric operator converges in operator norm to the inverse weighted Laplacian, with first correction -(eps/4) A^{-1} A_Q A^{-1}, Q the sum of squared shape operators.

limitationTriage.limitation: Sharp O(eps) operator-norm rate on general manifolds is not proved (O(eps^{1/2}) proved; O(eps) holds numerically on the circle).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does the L^2 operator-norm rate improve to O(eps)?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Remark 7.2 isolates the intermediate-frequency obstruction; circle evidence in Section 9.5.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: Population densities only; no empirical-sample or joint sampling/regularisation rates.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: What happens for empirical measures as n grows and eps shrinks?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Stated as scope; Mordant-Xu treat finite supports.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: Closed manifolds, smooth positive densities; no boundaries, vanishing densities or global geodesic-distance convergence; the correction needs known curvature.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do analogous expansions hold with boundaries or degenerate densities?
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: Beyond the scope of this release.

limitationTriage.limitation: Numerical scripts could be silently disabled under python -O or accept a corrupted value.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do the checks fail when an expected value is wrong, including under python -O?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: All checks are explicit (no assert); a corrupted circle first-order coefficient (-1/8 changed to -0.126) makes check_spheres_tori.py exit non-zero under -O (release gate negative control).
